svg.title: A goat receives the highest public-service prediction as the school route changes.
svg.desc: The recurring roll goat stands beneath the attendance scanner with a flawless record and a grand public-service icon. Behind the joke, the school transport route redraws through a narrow lane marked by old high water.
svg.text: Page 39, panel 5 · Comic pull-back from the attendance scanner to a transport-route update

text.tspan: The goat earns the highest public-service
prediction, and the same optimiser reroutes school
